description: This is a Java source file defining the class EntityEcaCondition, which represents a condition in an Entity Event Condition Automation (ECA) framework within the Apache OFBiz project. The class encapsulates logic to evaluate conditions based on entity fields or service calls, including comparison operations, and is used for entity event processing.

classes.name: EntityEcaCondition
classes.description: Represents a conditional expression used in entity event conditions, capable of evaluating either a service call or a comparison between entity fields or constant values.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition, either by invoking a service if configured as a service-based condition, or by comparing entity field values based on the operator and comparison type.

methods.name: getLValue
methods.description: Returns the left-hand side value name used in the condition.

methods.name: getRValue
methods.description: Returns the right-hand side value or constant value used in the condition, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used in the comparison, e.g., '=', '!=', '>', etc.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the condition, including service name, field names, operator, and other attributes.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the condition object based on its attributes.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality between this condition and another object.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns a list of field names involved in this condition, either the left-hand side or right-hand side fields.
